metadata.title: Harmonic Maps from Punctured Riemann Surfaces to the Hyperbolic Plane with Prescribed Scherk Asymptotics
metadata.abstract: Let $X$ be a genus $g\geq 0$ compact Riemann surface that admits an antiholomorphic involution $\iota$ with non empty fixed-point set, and let $D = \{p_1,\dots,p_k\}\subset \text{Fix}(\iota)$. At each puncture, we prescribe a Scherk map associated to a given real polynomial quadratic differential with even degree and negative leading coefficient. Here a Scherk map is the harmonic diffeomorphism from $\mathbb{C}$ to the interior of an ideal polygon in $\mathbb{H}^2$, whose Hopf differential is the given polynomial. We construct a harmonic map \[ h:X\backslash D \to \mathbb{H}^2 \] whose asymptotic behavior at each puncture matches the prescribed Scherk map. In particular, the image of $h$ tends to an ideal polygon near each end. The resulting $h$ covers harmonic maps obtained by taking the $\mathbb{H}^2$ factors of horizontal catenoids in $\mathbb{H}^2 \times \mathbb{R}$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在具有反全纯对合的穿孔 Riemann 曲面上，构造到双曲平面的调和映射，使各端匹配预先指定的 Scherk 渐近模型。
analysis.breakthrough: 可在多个穿孔同时指定几何渐近行为，并包含水平悬链面投影的已知例子。
analysis.limitations: 穿孔须位于对合不动点集，多项式要求偶数次数和负首项，不能宣称任意端数据均可实现。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露与 ChatGPT 5.6 plus 的引导对话启发了附录B用 Hessian 不等式证明 Hopf 微分在穿孔处亚纯的论证，并辅助简化命题7.4；作者核验、修正并负责。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露与 ChatGPT 5.6 plus 的引导对话启发了附录B用 Hessian 不等式证明 Hopf 微分在穿孔处亚纯的论证，并辅助简化命题7.4；作者核验、修正并负责。

analysis.priorityReason: 调和映射的非紧构造与渐近控制可供几何分析借鉴。
